text:
maya: quick thread — seeing weird func-call validation failures in the new q4f quant build on CI. failing only on one eval set.

 tom: which eval? the structured-output toolcall harness?

 maya: the "purchase_flow" funcall tests — they pass on cpu build, fail on quantized q4f and q8b.

 li: do you have a reproducer? stacktrace from runner?

 maya: pasted logs below (shrug)

 maya: ```json
{"error":"schema_validation","field":"payment.amount","expected":"number","got":"string","example_input":"\"12.00\""}
```

 anita: hmm looks like streaming reassembly issue where camera output sometimes yields tokenized quotes; could be NDJSON framing.

 dennis: I saw similar when we switched tokenizer to fastpiece — KV cache boundaries changed.

 maya: eval-bot: CI job #4678 failed: runner-smokewalk / eng-ml/eval - toolcall-structured - q4f - purchase_flow

 eval-bot: logs: https://ci.redwood/integrations/4678 (link)

 tom: ok assign: @li @anita can you bisect on the runner? suspect parse layer not trimming numeric tokens.

 li: doing a bisect now. quick note: metric definition for funcall correctness currently ignores type coercion — maybe tighten it.

 anita: agree — metric "funcall_schema_match" allows coercion for legacy tests; that masks failures on quantized models.

 maya: proposed change:

 maya: ```yaml
funcall_schema_match:
  strict_types: true
  ignore_extra_fields: false
```

 li: +1, but need to add a flag to CI to run legacy-coerce tests separately to avoid mass failures.

 tom: also add a small fuzzer that injects quoted numbers, floats, and exponentials to the purchase_flow set.

 maya: repro steps I used locally:

 maya: ```
make run-eval RUNNER=local-smoke MODEL=q4f ./evals/run --suite purchase_flow --seed 3
```

 dennis: I repro'd with that, turned out to be an NDJSON framing bug in the stream aggregator. fix patch incoming.

 anita: if the aggregator is stripping leading spaces, it can turn " 12.0" -> "12.0" fine, but quotes remain.

 dennis: pushing branch: fix/stream-ndjson-aggregation-4678

 dennis: PR: https://git.redwood/pulls/9021

 eval-bot: CI: triggered build for fix/stream-ndjson-aggregation-4678

 maya: after applying local patch, q4f reconverges, all funcall checks pass for purchase_flow.

 tom: can we add a dashboard tile to track funcall_schema_match by model/quant? add to console -> evals/structured-output

 anita: will add a per-model breakdown and a column for "type_coercions" count.

 li: created JIRA RED-1345 to track metric change + CI flagging.

 maya: thanks all. leaving test to run overnight. :thumbsup:

 tom: tagged release note: "fix: stream ndjson aggregation causing schema mismatches on quantized runners"

 eval-bot: merged #9021 into main — deploy queued.
